notes.title: Banana Shooter 1.361 Update - Knockout Mode
notes.content:
[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
Here are the new stuff that will be added to the game

[h2]New Server Mode - Knockout[/h2]
Its a lot more competitive mode than the default one!

[h3]Description[/h3]
In this mode you just play regularly like you did before, but only the top list players will survive for the future rounds, you cant join mid match you have to wait until there is the last one standing then the server will restart the mode so you can keep playing.

[h2]New Demo System[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/45a43f5f7c406aa3fae244b75e12986a9fc01fa5.png[/img]
This feature exists to record your match for content creators or who just want to check their gameplay, you can record your entire match then use the demo system to replay it in first person or third person more details [url=https://bs-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cinematic-tool/demo-camera.html]on our documentation[/url]

[h2]Demo Camera For Recording Cinematic[/h2]
[olist]
[*]First Person Spectate Support
[*]Camera movement lerping support
[*]Depth of field Support
[/olist]

[h2]New Chat UI[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/9d41a849218814abf2f502a9e6cee7b417faa35e.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]Selectable
[*]more visible
[/olist]

[h2]New Voichat UI[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Improved voice chat quality
[*]You can now see who is talking ingame
[*]Voice chat also works on voting scene
[/olist]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/a47d386b888b5d15c2701f5f343a58f8a8c0cfca.png[/img]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Add aim sensitivity multiplier setting
[*]Smoother when loading demo (The loading wont be running on the main thread)
[*]Implement third person weapon reloading animation
[*]No more rotating when crouching while looking down
[*]Smoother loading screen
[*]Fix vote timer when there arent enough players in the server
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.36 Map Editor Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Dedicated Server (No more host quit kinda)[/h1]

After 1 year of developing, the game grows a lot, so i can finally implement dedicated server feature instead of only p2p server which are host by players.

With the new dedicated server coming out, there shouldnt be any host quit anymore unless you still want to play on a player hosted server.

Beside this, i will also publish the dedicated server to everyone who owns the game, you can search for "Banana Shooter Dedicated Server" in your library. We have a full tutorial on how to host your own server on [url=https://bs-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/]our official documentation[/url]

[h1]Map Editor[/h1]

I apologize for the confusion, since i said the map editor will come out in a few weeks last year, but it didnt come true, but now it did come true. Im glad to announce the map editor is now officially released.
You can use it right now by opening the game. Yes it has been integrated within the game itself no need to download anything else.

[url=https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/01fedf204c8b4aad2b7a9d508f69cdf16a41f7a1.png][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/01fedf204c8b4aad2b7a9d508f69cdf16a41f7a1.png[/img][/url]

The map editor is still in beta so it might be a little buggy but the most part of it is working great. If you find any issues please report them in the [url=https://discord.gg/bananashooter]Official Discord Server[/url]

[h2]Supported Features[/h2]

- 1. Modelable meshes
- 2. Built-in decorations
- 3. Built-in decals
- 3. External textures
- 4. External audios
- 5. External models / maps
- 6. External decals

[h2]Workshop Integration[/h2]

The map editor should work with the steam workshop, so you must have steam opened in the background to let it work.

[h3]In-Game Workshop Browser Showcase[/h3]

[url=https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/de8b49ab48ae450c060f81220090869de3eaf110.png][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/de8b49ab48ae450c060f81220090869de3eaf110.png[/img][/url]

[h1]First Purchasable Bundle[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/1949740/browse/?filter=All]Click here for more info[/url]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/6963a3962343b2bd2c6a59cc976ba3dfb5e316b8.png[/img]

[h1]Summer Case 2023[/h1]

Its summer time, I'm glad to announce that we finally have official gun skins in game which you can get it by playing the game, after a match you will have a chance to get the summer case. Opening it to get some cool skins for you

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42196032/c6be16f67e593f30778c67df4895a5422f0ded16.png[/img]

[h1]New Gamemode[/h1]

- 1. Catch the Banana
   - At the start of the match a player gets the banana
   - Kill the banana holder to get the banana
   - Person with the banana will get more time
   - Person with the highest time wins
- 2. One Shot One Kill
   - Players can be killed in one shot
   - Players only have Knife and Desert Eagle
   - Desert Eagle only has 1 bullet

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Small Improvements[/h2]

- 1. Snipers (BWP & Barrett M82) no longer have a no-scope crosshair
- 2. Remade Endless Mode (start with a pistol and earn money by killing enemies to buy advanced weapons)
- 3. Smoother Player Animation
- 4. Revamped blood particles
- 5. Completely New Inventory Menu
- 6. Added 8 new intro themes
   - Can be changed using the intro_theme {number} command
   - Values above 8 will use intro theme 8
- 7. Updated Steam Rich presence
- 8. Fixed Achievements
- 9. Added popup at the start of matches that describes the gamemode
- 10. Add "bulk_open" command to the console
